third_party_evaluations.summary: KISA-administered auditor for Korea's combined ISMS-P scheme.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded Korean government recognition and a three-year combined security/privacy audit profile support professional assurance responsibility; that recognition does not establish equivalence to Japanese national schemes.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Korean government recognition and the combined ISMS-P auditor role support professional assurance responsibility with a three-year profile. The record lacks practical-assessment details and US recognition evidence, limiting operational hiring conclusions.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded combined information-security and privacy audit scope with three years of experience supports professional assurance. Korean government recognition establishes the scheme context without implying EU regulatory equivalence or offensive skill.
